headline: SK Hynix Q3 Operating Profit Surges 630% on AI Memory Demand
summary: SK Hynix reported a 632% year-on-year surge in third-quarter operating profit driven by strong demand for advanced memory chips used in artificial intelligence. However, the profit figure fell short of analyst expectations.
why: SK Hynix is a major global supplier of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) chips essential for AI accelerators, making its financial performance a core metric for global semiconductor demand.
why_moved: Rapid demand for AI memory chips boosted operating earnings, but results missing high analyst estimates heightened investor concerns over long-term AI spending sustainability.
